def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       if grid[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
         a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b,grid[a][b]))
         for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
          x,y=a+da,b+db
          if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
           seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
        objs.append(cells)
    if not objs:return []
    r0=min(x for o in objs for x,y,v in o); c0=min(y for o in objs for x,y,v in o)
    # every object has same dimensions and foreground color
    oh=max(x for x,y,v in objs[0])-min(x for x,y,v in objs[0])+1
    ow=max(y for x,y,v in objs[0])-min(y for x,y,v in objs[0])+1
    fg=Counter(v for o in objs for x,y,v in o).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[fg]*ow for _ in range(oh)]
    for o in objs:
     rr=min(x for x,y,v in o); cc=min(y for x,y,v in o)
     for x,y,v in o:
      if v!=fg: out[x-rr][y-cc]=v
    return out
